timing_classification: diagnostic; not formal idle-mdx performance acceptance
python_role: independent CPU accuracy oracle, fixture generation and validation orchestration only
comparison: CPU Galerkin generation versus CUDA Galerkin generation; identical GPU solve and host setup threads

interrupted_attempts.reason: Concurrent numerical benchmark detected before first MATLAB benchmark output

limitations: Manufactured unit-cube lowest-order HCurl case only; not a complete application or Simulink model benchmark.
Continuous public-API time includes native setup, setup transfers, hierarchy/RHS upload, solve, result gather and synchronization; excludes FE assembly, HDF5 reading and validation.
Setup GPU peak is exact simultaneously owned native CUDA allocation; solve memory is a live allocation delta. These differ in lifetime, are not summed and are not whole-process peaks.
Zero before-optimization setup GPU bytes means Galerkin generation ran on CPU; the subsequent GPU solve still allocates device memory.
All allocation admission guards reserve max(2 GiB,20% total GPU memory); available memory and conservative benchmark duplication estimates also limit each run.
First calls are excluded from warmed ABBA medians; MATLAB startup was not recorded for the first scaling stage.

gpu_memory_admission_plan.method: Conservative admission estimate; includes duplicate benchmark uploads; not allocator peak
